rationale: C17 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It concerns the same lead carrier, uses the same three-part Railway Labor Act predicate, follows the same operative sequence, imposes the same thirty-day reporting and status-quo requirements, and appends a regionally organized carrier list with extensive concrete overlap. The child adapts that template by changing the represented employees and revising the carrier list. C11 is also structurally close and likely relevant to the child’s plural-carrier formulation, but C17 is stronger because it matches the Akron, Canton & Youngstown lead carrier and much of the attached list. C08 shares the standard emergency-board language but lacks the distinctive multi-carrier and list machinery.

shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim, distinctive framing of the dispute around the same lead carrier and an incorporated carrier list.
